scope: Automotive surface and bounded polygon baseline; not the complete CATIA command set.

polyline.limits: At least 2 points; t is normalized segment index, not arc length.

circle_arc.limits: Caller supplies orthonormal plane axes and positive radius; angles in radians.

ellipse.limits: Caller supplies orthonormal plane axes and positive radii; angles in radians.

bezier_curve.limits: Degree 1..5; t in [0,1]; finite control points.

nurbs_curve.limits: Degree 1..5; poles <=32; ordinary XYZ plus positive weight; valid full knot vector required. Returns p,d,dd.

catmull_rom.limits: One uniform Catmull-Rom segment between p1 and p2; not centripetal parameterization.

curve_trim.limits: Parameter interval mapping for an existing curve; caller checks interval is in the curve domain.

plane.limits: Finite independent nonzero direction vectors; rectangular domain [0,1]^2.

bezier_patch.limits: Nonrational tensor patch, 2..6 poles per direction, row-major U then V.

nurbs_patch.limits: 2..32 poles per axis, degree 1..5 below pole count; finite positive weights and monotonic full knots; caller ensures legal multiplicities.

ruled_surface.limits: Two compatible nonrational B-spline curves sharing degree, knots and pole count <=32.

extrude_surface.limits: Rational profile <=32 poles, degree 1..5; nonzero finite extrusion; valid profile required.

revolve_surface.limits: Exact rational rotation about Y; profile (radius,axial_y,0,weight); nonzero span <=2pi split into <=4 arcs. U is rational arc parameter, not linear angle.

sweep_surface.limits: GPU exact translation surface A(u)+B(v), <=32 poles/axis; general path sweep uses CPU CAD kernel. No arbitrary GPU moving-frame sweep claim.

loft_surface.limits: GPU natural cubic interpolation through 2..11 uniformly spaced, compatible nonrational sections; <=32 poles/section. General wires use CPU CAD kernel.

coons_fill.limits: Four cubic nonrational Bezier boundaries with matching corners; exact bicubic Coons construction.

offset_surface.limits: One-level offset of a regular NURBS surface, sampled by its normal; current arena holds 14 objects. STEP retains native offset definition; no global self-intersection guarantee.

fill_nside.limits: CPU variational CAD filling; C0/G1/G2 constraints need appropriate support faces. Batch verifies a warped five-edge C0 boundary.

blend_g1.limits: Cubic strip matching compatible rail positions and cross derivatives; derivatives supplied by caller, no automatic global shape optimization.

blend_g2.limits: Quintic strip matching compatible rail positions and first/second cross derivatives; degree V <=5, poles V <=32.

continuity_check.limits: Regular coincident seam samples. Returns gap, unsigned tangent-plane angle and curvature mismatch in 3 tangent directions; sample evidence is not global Class-A certification.

curvature.limits: Returns Gaussian K, signed mean H and surface Jacobian. Zero Jacobian flags a singular/degenerate point where K/H are not valid.

project_curve.limits: CPU normal projection of a native CAD curve; failure raises ValueError.

intersect_surfaces.limits: CPU intersection of native untrimmed surfaces; returns native 3D curves; not a full solid Boolean operation.

trim_surface.limits: CPU B-rep construction from simple closed UV polygon loops; straight UV edges, optional holes; caller provides noncrossing loops within the parameter domain.

split_surface.limits: CPU native CAD splitter with caller-supplied tool shapes; result must be a valid B-rep.

join_curves.limits: CPU composite B-spline conversion; ordered, connected compatible native curves; rejects disconnected input.

sew.limits: CPU face sewing; solid=True requires one closed shell, followed by orientation/validity check; does not union overlapping solids.

box.limits: Axis-aligned finite strict min/max; 8 vertices, 12 triangles.

uv_sphere.limits: Positive radius; segments>=3, rings>=2; count must fit 4096 vertices/4096 triangles.

cylinder.limits: Z-aligned closed faceted cylinder; positive radius/height; segments>=3.

cone.limits: Z-aligned closed cone with one apex; positive bottom radius/height; segments>=3. Same function also supports truncated cones.

torus.limits: Z-axis ring torus; major>minor>0; both segment counts>=3; bounded mesh capacity.

grid.limits: Independent plane vectors; steps>=1; optional sin(pi*u)sin(pi*v) displacement along the plane normal; open mesh.

triangulate_polygon.limits: Ear clipping of one planar simple convex/concave polygon, 3..64 distinct vertices, no holes or collinear overlaps; absolute geometric tolerances.

extrude_face.limits: Fresh destination; one planar simple polygon <=64 corners; positive extrusion dot polygon normal; creates caps and walls.

inset_face.limits: Fresh destination; strictly convex planar polygon <=64; fraction in (0,1); shrinks toward vertex centroid, not constant-distance edge offset.

subdivide.limits: Fresh separate destination; linear 1-to-4 triangle subdivision and shared-midpoint welding; preserves shape, not Catmull-Clark smoothing.

weld.limits: Positive finite tolerance; first representative within radius; O(n^2); does not remove degenerate faces created by a large tolerance.

normals.limits: Area-weighted vertex normals; valid oriented indexed triangles required; sharp edges require split vertices.

bevel_vertices.limits: Vertex truncation of a closed convex tri-valent polyhedron: <=64 vertices, <=96 edges, convex faces <=16 corners; fraction in (0,0.5). Unsupported valence rejected; not general edge filleting.

translate.limits: Finite coordinates. Apply to control points or mesh vertices; vectors/derivatives omit translation.

rotate.limits: Finite nonzero arbitrary axis; radians; Rodrigues rotation.

scale.limits: Finite component scales; negative scales reflect orientation; caller updates face winding and normals for whole meshes.

mirror.limits: Finite nonzero arbitrary plane normal; caller updates face winding and normals for whole meshes.
